name: What factors influence the cost of a luxury gut renovation?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of a luxury gut renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a luxury gut renovation is influenced by several factors: the size of the home, the extent of structural changes, the quality of materials and finishes chosen (e.g., custom cabinetry, high-end appliances), and the complexity of new systems like smart home technology. Additionally, site-specific challenges or extensive landscaping can impact the overall budget. Engaging with a design-build firm early helps establish a clear budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury gut renovation costs depend on home size, structural changes, material quality, system complexity, and site-specific challenges.
